method.percentile: Kubara hagati y'imyanya yegeranye: umwanya h = (n − 1) × p / 100; agaciro = x[⌊h⌋] + (h − ⌊h⌋) × (x[⌊h⌋+1] − x[⌊h⌋]). Birahishwa iyo n iri munsi y'umubare muto wemewe.
method.ratioOfSums: Agaciro rusange = iminota yose ÷ iminsi y'abarwayi yose (igabanya ry'ibiteranyo, si impuzandengo y'abakozi). Birahishwa iyo iminsi y'abarwayi iri munsi y'umubare muto wemewe.
method.baselineIndex: Igipimo = iminota y'ubu ku munsi w'umurwayi ÷ iminota ku munsi w'umurwayi mu gihe cy'IFATIZO RY'IGERAGEZA (ibyumweru 4 bya mbere — si ifatizo ryemejwe). Ntikigaragazwa iyo uruhande rumwe rufite iminsi y'abarwayi iri munsi y'umubare muto wemewe.
